description: This file defines a class SugarWidgetFieldURL that extends SugarWidgetFieldVarchar. The class is responsible for rendering URL fields as clickable links in the SugarCRM/SuiteCRM interface.

classes.name: SugarWidgetFieldURL
classes.description: A class to render URL fields as clickable links in list views.

methods.name: displayList
methods.description: Returns HTML anchor tag with target set to _blank, linking to the URL value extracted from layout_def.
